title: A Flicker After Closing
story: At the lighthouse museum, whoever locks up for the night writes one line in the lock-up log. Four volunteers took the nights from Thursday to Sunday, and each wrote about something different, but not one of them signed or dated a line. Lena, gloves on, is most curious about one note: an odd flicker, high in the dark lantern room, after closing time. Who locked up on which night, and who saw the flicker?

texts: The Sunday volunteer noted either the gull nest or the stuck latch.
The volunteer who noted the stuck latch locked up exactly 2 nights after the volunteer who noted the odd flicker.
Priya noted either the odd flicker or the wet paint.
Arlo locked up the night after the volunteer who noted the odd flicker.
The volunteer who noted the wet paint locked up on either Thursday or Sunday.
The Thursday volunteer is either Priya or Della.
The Sunday volunteer is neither Teddy nor Arlo.

trace.text: Clue 1 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
Clue 3 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
Clue 5 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
The wet paint note must go with Thursday: clue 5 rules out Friday and Saturday; clue 1 rules out Sunday.
Clue 6 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).

Since the stuck latch note can still be only Friday, Saturday, or Sunday and the odd flicker note can still be only Friday or Saturday, clue 2 means the stuck latch note cannot be Friday or Saturday and the odd flicker note cannot be Saturday.
The stuck latch note must go with Sunday: clue 2 rules out Friday and Saturday; Thursday already goes with the wet paint note.
The odd flicker note must go with Friday: clue 2 rules out Saturday; clue 1 rules out Sunday; Thursday already goes with the wet paint note.
The gull nest note must go with Saturday: the other choices are already taken.
Sunday must go with Della: clue 7 rules out Teddy and Arlo; Priya is already ruled out for the stuck latch note.
Thursday must go with Priya: clue 6 rules out Teddy and Arlo; Della already goes with Sunday.
The wet paint note must go with Priya: Teddy, Della, and Arlo are already ruled out for Thursday.
The stuck latch note goes with Sunday, so the stuck latch note also goes with Della.
Arlo must go with the gull nest note: clue 4 rules out the odd flicker note; the wet paint note is already ruled out for Thursday; the stuck latch note already goes with Della.
Teddy must go with the odd flicker note: the stuck latch note is already ruled out for Sunday; the wet paint note is already ruled out for Thursday; the gull nest note already goes with Arlo.
Friday goes with the odd flicker note, so Friday also goes with Teddy.
Arlo must go with Saturday: clue 6 rules out Thursday; clue 7 rules out Sunday; Friday already goes with Teddy.
